_comment: Content-pinned acknowledgements for placeholder_check.py (round 429). Each entry says WHY a template token in the permanent record cannot be filled. `hash` is sha256[:16] of the 7 lines centred on the hole (placeholder_check.context_hash), NOT the path or the line number: edit that passage and the acknowledgement expires as U003 instead of muting the location forever -- see skills/content-pinned-acknowledgement. `line_when_pinned` is a human breadcrumb and is never matched on. All six entries here are historical: every one belongs to a session that ended before its measurement landed, and each reason states what was checked to conclude the number is unrecoverable rather than merely inconvenient. A SEVENTH hole is an ERROR, which is the whole point -- do not add an entry to make a fresh round's own unfinished run go quiet.
